title: India, That Is Bharat
introduction: India, That Is Bharat is explored through people, places, time, institutions and economic or cultural relationships. Key source-grounded themes include India, That Is Bharat, observation, reasoning, application, evidence, reflection. Gurukul reorganises these into questions, comparisons, evidence tasks and real-life applications without reproducing textbook prose.
